description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'Featured' within the OpenCart admin module system, responsible for managing the 'Featured' module's CRUD operations (view, save, add, delete) and rendering the module configuration interface.

classes.name: Featured
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Featured module in the OpenCart admin interface, providing methods for rendering the module configuration page, saving module data, adding new modules, and deleting modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the Featured module configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, loading module info, product info, and preparing data for the view template.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the Featured module configuration, including permission check, validation, and database update.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new Featured module with default name and permissions, returning success status.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified Featured module based on module_id, with permission validation.
